say.guildmark.greet_6: Ah, one of the guild folk.
say.guildmark.farmer_1: Rain's coming. I can feel it.
say.guildmark.fisher_2: You should've seen the one that got away.
say.guildmark.gossip_0: Did you hear? A troll in the hills.
say.guildmark.gossip_3: Hollow soldiers on the north road.
say.guildmark.gossip_8: They say the old king's crown was broken.
say.guildmark.gossip_9: Best bread in the city, that bakery.
say.guildmark.gossip_10: A rider in black, at night. I saw it.
say.guildmark.gossip_11: The roads are safer since the guild came.
say.guildmark.merchant_2: Best in the city, I swear it!
say.guildmark.merchant_3: Silks and spices from the south!
say.guildmark.noble_1: Have you seen the cathedral? Magnificent.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_0: There we are. That'll see you home.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_1: Evening. The lamps are going up.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_2: Not a dark street in the city tonight.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_0: Morning. The sun can take it from here.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_1: There. That's the night seen off.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_2: Rest now. I'll be back at dusk.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_hello_0: Can't stop long. I've a round to finish.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_hello_2: Someone has to see to the lamps.
say.guildmark.mage_0: The stars were clear last night. Rare, these days.
say.guildmark.mage_2: Has anyone seen my quill? I had it a moment ago.
say.guildmark.mage_3: Four hundred years of star charts, and no two nights alike.
say.guildmark.mage_5: Light bends, if you ask it nicely.
say.guildmark.mage_kin_0: Well met, friend of the Starwatch.
say.guildmark.knight_0: Keep the fire. Keep the road.
say.guildmark.knight_1: Ring's open, if you fancy a bout.
say.guildmark.knight_2: Watch your feet. Most fights are lost at the feet.
say.guildmark.knight_3: The Hollow walked again last night.
say.guildmark.knight_5: The Commander had us drilling before dawn.
say.guildmark.knight_kin_1: Good to have you with us.
say.guildmark.knight_cold_0: We have nothing to say to thieves.
say.guildmark.thief_0: Didn't see me. Nobody ever does.
say.guildmark.thief_1: Nice boots. Shame if they walked off.
say.guildmark.thief_4: I've a cousin who can get you one of those. Cheap.
say.guildmark.thief_5: Mind your purse round here. Not everyone's as honest as me.
say.guildmark.thief_kin_1: The Widow speaks well of you. Don't let it go to your head.
say.guildmark.driver_quiet: Road's quiet. I don't like it.
say.guildmark.driver_greet: Good day! Mind the wheels, now.
say.guildmark.driver_took: They came out of nowhere and took the lot.
say.guildmark.driver_ran: I ran. I'm not proud of it.
say.guildmark.driver_mark: Their camp's out that way. Here, I'll show you.
say.guildmark.driver_next: The next one won't go without more spears.
say.guildmark.driver_escort_meet: You're our escort? Then let's be off.
say.guildmark.driver_escort_done: Never been so glad to see a wall.
say.guildmark.driver_bye: Mind how you go out there.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_1: The wagons aren't safe on the road these days.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_2: Everything off the wagons is dear now.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_3: My brother drives a wagon. I worry for him.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_4: Outlaws on the road, and nobody does a thing.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_5: Somebody ought to deal with those outlaws.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_6: They say the last wagon never came in.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_7: Bread's gone up again. It's that road.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_8: I won't set foot outside the walls till it's sorted.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_1: Wagons are coming in again. About time.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_2: They say the outlaws were broken. Good riddance.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_3: Prices are coming down, thank goodness.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_4: The road's safe again, they say.
say.guildmark.guard_beaten_off: That's it, run! And stay gone!
say.guildmark.guard_cant_hold: There's too many! Can't hold them!
say.guildmark.guard_glad: Glad of you. Watch the treeline.
say.guildmark.crier_open_1: Hear ye, hear ye! News from the market!
say.guildmark.crier_open_2: Gather round, good people, and hear the news!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_wheat: Blight in the fields! The wheat is failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_carrot: Blight in the fields! The carrots are failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_potato: Blight in the fields! The potatoes are failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_beetroot: Blight in the fields! The beetroot is failing!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_wheat: A bumper crop of wheat is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_carrot: A bumper crop of carrots is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_potato: A bumper crop of potatoes is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_beetroot: A bumper crop of beetroot is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_murrain: Murrain among the herds! Meat and hides will be dear!
say.guildmark.crier_fowl_pest: A pest has got among the hens!
say.guildmark.crier_mill_broken: The windmill's sails are broken! Flour will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_oven_cracked: The bakery's oven has cracked! Bread will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_good_catch: The boats are coming in full! Fish is cheap at the quay!
say.guildmark.crier_poor_catch: The nets come up empty! Fish will be dear!
say.guildmark.crier_fever: A fever is going round the town! Keep warm, and rest!
say.guildmark.crier_over_blight: The blight has passed from the fields!
say.guildmark.crier_over_poor_catch: The fish are back in the nets!
say.guildmark.crier_dear_string: String and twine are dear today!
say.guildmark.crier_cheap_string: String and twine are cheap today!
say.guildmark.crier_why_bought_up: Folk have been buying it up!
say.guildmark.crier_why_sold_in: The stalls are piled high with it!
say.guildmark.crier_why_no_flour: The ovens stood cold for want of flour!
say.guildmark.crier_why_no_grain: The mill stood idle for want of grain!
say.guildmark.crier_why_short_handed: Too few hands to make it!
say.guildmark.crier_why_rest_day: The ovens rest on the seventh day!
say.guildmark.crier_why_carts_behind: The carts are behind with the harvest!
say.guildmark.crier_why_worn_tools: The town's tools are worn out!
say.guildmark.crier_why_from_afar: It must come from afar, by caravan!
say.guildmark.crier_why_cold: Every hearth is burning coal against the cold!
say.guildmark.crier_why_warm: Few fires are lit in the warm days!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fields_lean: Little grows in the fields this time of year!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fields_full: The fields are at their best!
say.guildmark.crier_why_orchard_lean: The orchards won't bear till autumn!
say.guildmark.crier_why_orchard_full: The orchards are heavy with fruit!
say.guildmark.crier_why_herds_lean: Few beasts go to the butcher in the cold!
say.guildmark.crier_why_herds_full: The fattened beasts are going to the butcher!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fleece_lean: The sheep won't be shorn till spring!
say.guildmark.crier_why_coops_lean: The coops give little in the short days!
say.guildmark.crier_why_coops_full: The coops are doing well in the long days!
say.guildmark.crier_hungry: The town went hungry yesterday! Food is short!
say.guildmark.crier_quiet: The market is well stocked, and prices are fair!
say.guildmark.crier_board: The prices are up on the board!
say.guildmark.crier_news_slain: A great beast has been slain!
say.guildmark.crier_news_sea: A terror of the deep has been slain!
say.guildmark.crier_news_lair: A monster's lair has been cleared!
say.guildmark.crier_news_rank: The guild has a new champion!
say.guildmark.crier_news_works: A village has finished its new works!
say.guildmark.crier_news_road: A new road is open to travellers!
say.guildmark.crier_news_siege_won: A village has held off a siege!
say.guildmark.crier_news_siege_lost: A village has been overrun by a horde!
say.guildmark.crier_news_outlaws: Outlaws are abroad! Keep to the roads by day!
say.guildmark.crier_news_outlaw_slain: An outlaw captain has been brought down!
say.guildmark.crier_news_rescued: A captive has been brought home!
say.guildmark.crier_news_guild: A new guild has been founded!
say.guildmark.crier_news_banners: Banners are changing over the villages!
say.guildmark.crier_news_king: The Hollow King is no more!
say.guildmark.crier_news_deeds: Great deeds are afoot in the land!
say.guildmark.crier_news_more: More word from the guild halls!
say.guildmark.crier_festival_soon: A festival is coming! Make ready!
say.guildmark.crier_festival_today: The festival is today! Come one, come all!
say.guildmark.crier_season_spring: Spring has come! Time to sow!
say.guildmark.crier_season_autumn: Autumn is upon us! Bring in the harvest!
say.guildmark.crier_season_winter: Winter has come! Lay in your stores!
say.guildmark.crier_waylaid: A wagon was waylaid on the road! Goods will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_over_waylaid: The wagons are getting through again!
say.guildmark.crier_road_troubled: Trouble on the road! Escorts wanted for the wagons!
say.guildmark.crier_road_perilous: The road is perilous! The wagons go together, at noon!
say.guildmark.crier_road_closed: The road is closed! No wagon goes without an escort!
say.guildmark.crier_road_clear: The outlaws are broken! The road is clear again!
say.guildmark.crier_relief: A relief wagon is on its way to us!
say.guildmark.crier_salvage_returned: Goods from the wreck have been brought back! Our thanks!
say.guildmark.crier_close_0: That is the news! Go about your business!
say.guildmark.crier_close_2: So ends the news! Fair trading to you all!
say.guildmark.crier_works_wanted_oven: The town asks for a second oven! Pledge what you can!
say.guildmark.crier_works_wanted_granary: The town asks for a granary! Pledge what you can!
say.guildmark.crier_works_wanted_great_g: The town asks for a great granary! Pledge what you can!
say.guildmark.crier_works_wanted_tower: The town asks for a watchtower on the road! Pledge what you can!
say.guildmark.crier_works_funded_oven: The second oven is paid for! Our thanks to all who gave!
say.guildmark.crier_works_funded_granary: The granary is paid for! Our thanks to all who gave!
say.guildmark.crier_works_funded_great_g: The great granary is paid for! Our thanks to all who gave!
say.guildmark.crier_works_funded_tower: The watchtower is paid for! Our thanks to all who gave!
say.guildmark.crier_works_raised_oven: The second oven is built, by the gift of a friend of the town!
say.guildmark.crier_works_raised_granary: The granary is raised, by the gift of a friend of the town!
say.guildmark.crier_works_raised_great_g: The great granary is raised, by the gift of a friend of the town!
say.guildmark.crier_works_raised_tower: The watchtower is raised, by the gift of a friend of the town!
say.guildmark.crier_times_hard: Hard times, friends. Help where you can.
say.guildmark.crier_times_lean: Lean times in the town! Look out for your neighbours!
say.guildmark.crier_times_steady: Steady times in the town! Neither feast nor famine!
say.guildmark.crier_times_good: Good times in the town! The stalls are busy!
say.guildmark.crier_times_thriving: The town is thriving! Fortune smiles on us all!
say.guildmark.crier_times_still_hard: Times are still hard! Share what you can!
say.guildmark.crier_times_still_lean: Times are lean still! Waste nothing!
say.guildmark.crier_times_still_good: Times are still good! Long may they last!
say.guildmark.crier_times_still_thriving: The town is thriving still! Fortune is with us!
say.guildmark.homestead_hello_3: She'll be up before you know it.
say.guildmark.homestead_hello_4: Keep the crate full and we'll keep at it.
say.guildmark.homestead_need_stone: No stone left in the crate!
say.guildmark.homestead_need_glass: We'll want glass for the windows.
say.guildmark.homestead_need_free: We'll wait for the ground to clear.
say.guildmark.homestead_wait_2: Let's see what the plans say.
say.guildmark.works_master_survey_2: A bit to the left. There!
say.guildmark.works_master_plumb_2: Not a hair out of true. Good.
say.guildmark.works_master_wagon_1: The wagon's in. Unload it, lads.
say.guildmark.works_master_wagon_2: The wagon's here. Look lively, now!
say.guildmark.works_master_toast_2: To the town, and all who built it!
say.guildmark.works_master_opening_1: It's done. May it serve you well.
say.guildmark.works_master_plaque_1: There. Your name, for all to see.
